svg.title: Frobenius decomposes the extension-field groups
svg.desc: For ECCp-131, the target prime factor is confined to the base-field summand in both extensions.
svg.text: For ECCp-131, the target prime factor is confined to the base-field summand in both extensions.
For the published curve: gcd(n,n′)=gcd(n,M₃)=1, n≠2,3. These are checked arithmetic conditions.
Here the group has odd order, so division by 2 is defined.
Set ρ₂=e₊. For R∈E(𝔽p), the twist component e₋R is zero.
For a finite point with x∈𝔽p, the y-coordinate has
degree dividing both 2 and 3, hence lies in 𝔽p.

svg.text: Projection constrains any resulting relation; it does not rule out every algebraic improvement in how relations are generated.
The displayed direct products use the checked ECCp-131 hypotheses. Without them, intersections and primary-component issues require care.
